question: Does external TRAINING data improve a detector evaluated on the supplied press data? No external benchmark evaluation or final-model selection.
status: registered before this experiment's model outcomes; target and some external outcomes were previously explored

target.source: original competition CSVs, canonical exact-duplicate removal and recording boundaries from master core
target.fit: normal only, existing P0/P1/P2 forward time partitions
target.calibration: same real target normal calibration records in every arm; never augmented
target.evaluation: each fold's later normal records plus all 21 provided abnormal records; same single abnormal episode across folds
target.quantization: existing matched input precision, both classes identically
target.unit: completed recording; no claim about early row detection
target.test_independence: retrospective comparison, NOT a new unseen test; no anomaly labels used in fit, pretraining or thresholds

shared_representation.type: 16-bin square-root normalized positive-frequency energy distribution per vibration channel
shared_representation.frequency_axis: relative to each signal's available frequency range, NOT matched physical Hz
shared_representation.time_signal: subtract own window mean, rFFT, discard DC, square magnitudes, integrate frequency-bin mass into 16 equal relative bands, normalize total and take square root
shared_representation.espset: use supplied spectrum amplitudes; discard first/DC bin, square magnitudes and apply the same relative-band integration; never reconstruct an unobserved time waveform
shared_representation.physical_limits: SKAB and UCI are low-rate vibration magnitude/envelope sequences; Beihang and press are waveform-like; ESPset spectra are speed-normalized velocity. Representation compatibility is an empirical transfer hypothesis, not sensor equivalence.
shared_representation.short_target_record: retain in denominator; vibration-only view abstains and counts as no alarm; integrated view falls back to the fixed target detector

external_usage.normal_pool: UCI all four components nominal AND stable; SKAB every observation unambiguously normal, excluding conflicts; Beihang Healthy state files; ESPset Normal label
external_usage.pretraining_pool: all external vibration examples without using their fault labels as target labels
external_usage.skab: deduplicate shared captures using existing 30-group mapping; split on gaps >1.5 median positive interval within group; preserve label-conflict audit
external_usage.beihang: each axis has its own time-value pair; split time reversals/gaps before nonoverlapping 32-sample windows; at most 256 evenly spaced windows per file/axis
external_usage.uci: one 32-sample VS1 window per 60-sample cycle; EPS1 power is never substituted for target current
external_usage.sampling: without replacement; shuffled round-robin across acquisition groups; all_four has equal per-source quotas, unmet quotas not filled by another source
external_usage.old_external_reservations: external files, including formerly reserved groups, are training-only for this separate user-requested experiment; previous results remain preserved and are not re-labelled as unseen tests

pooled_knn.training: target normal vibration examples plus selected external normal examples
pooled_knn.duplicate_control: repeat target examples by identity then deduplicate; identical predictions required
pooled_knn.fit_reference_scores: exclude both vibration channels from the query's own target recording

pretrained_ae.finetune: target fit normal vibration examples only
pretrained_ae.compute_control: same initialization, 300 target-only pretrain steps then 300 target-only finetune steps; reset optimizer between phases for all arms

views.vibration_only: maximum of the two channel anomaly scores; all target records retained
views.integrated: maximum of fixed target-only Press Guard v2 score and vibration score converted with fit-only ExpTail; normal calibration rerun identically for every arm; v2 is a fixed reference, not selected as final by this study
views.base_reference: Press Guard v2 refitted on the same P0/P1/P2 fit/cal records

metrics.threshold: (1 + number of target calibration scores >= query)/(n_target_cal + 1) <= alpha; ties conservative

interpretation: Report paired differences against the same method's target-only control, seed and fold stability, and the unaugmented fixed base. Do not select the best seed, pool reused abnormal episodes as independent failures, or infer universal unusability from these two transfer routes. No field-generalization claim.
termination: Run the registered arms and summarize training utility; no new external validation project, probability head, web UI, or final submission model in this task.
